verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS domain registrar, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no assistant inside the Porkbun product. Its agentic features are all external: an official MCP server for Claude, Cursor and other clients, plus llms.txt instructions written for outside coding agents. These let users delegate tasks to third-party agents, not to an assistant built into the product.
